scripts.setup: node scripts/check-env.mjs && npm ci && npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix functions
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix functions
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix web && node scripts/harness/check.mjs --code
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-env.mjs && npm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names emu,fn,web,seed "firebase emulators:start --project konbu-devfest-hackathon-2026" "npm run watch --prefix functions" "npm run dev --prefix web" "node scripts/seed.mjs"
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-env.mjs && npm run lint && npm run build && node --test scripts/functions.test.mjs scripts/web.test.mjs scripts/map-declutter.test.mjs && AI_PASSPHRASE=smoke-test-passphrase firebase emulators:exec --project konbu-devfest-hackathon-2026 --only hosting,auth,firestore,functions,storage "node scripts/smoke.mjs local && node scripts/sim-headless.mjs"
